typography.h1: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter text-gray-900 leading-tight

surfaces: Crystal Glass for Sticky Navbar: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-gray-200/50
Solid Flat for Cards: bg-gray-50 border border-gray-100 rounded-2xl hover:shadow-xl hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300
Grid Borders for Tarifs Table to give technical precision.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient shadows for floating elements, sharp 1px borders to separate white-on-white layers.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or smooth rounded-xl. Primary button: bg-yellow-400 text-black font-semibold hover:bg-yellow-500 hover:scale-105 transition-transform.

layout_and_grids.spacing: Generous. Use py-24 for desktop sections, py-16 for mobile. Gap-6 or gap-8 in grids.
layout_and_grids.bento_grid: For Advantages and Services. Mix of col-span-1 and col-span-2 on desktop. 1-col on mobile.
layout_and_grids.mobile_first: All buttons must be min-h-[48px] for touch targets. Grids fall back to grid-cols-1. Padding container px-4 sm:px-6.

components_to_use.name: Table
components_to_use.notes: For the Tarifs section, high contrast headers

components_to_use.name: Card
components_to_use.notes: Use flat gray-50 style, not bordered generic white

components_to_use.name: Marquee
components_to_use.notes: For the cities served, editorial ribbon style

components_to_use.name: Lucide React
components_to_use.notes: For service icons, phone, whatsapp, etc

motion_and_interactions.reveal: Use framer-motion to stagger-fade-up cards as they scroll into view.
motion_and_interactions.micro: Hover states on buttons must scale up (1.05) and increase shadow. Cards must lift (-translate-y-1).

sections_instructions.name: Sticky Navbar
sections_instructions.guidelines: Fixed top-0, z-50, backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80. Must contain Logo, lang switcher, 'Réserver' button. Hidden links behind mobile menu.

sections_instructions.name: Hero Section
sections_instructions.guidelines: Desktop: Split layout. Left: H1 'Votre Chauffeur Privé à Fontainebleau', subtext, 2 large CTAs (Book in yellow, Call in gray outline). Right: Image of White Mercedes S-Class. Overlay stats (20+ years, 4.9 rating) as floating glass pills. Mobile: Image on top or background with gradient, text below, CTAs prominently fixed or sticky.

sections_instructions.name: Marquee Cities
sections_instructions.guidelines: Slow, elegant scrolling text of cities served. bg-gray-50 text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-sm py-4 border-y border-gray-100.

sections_instructions.name: Services Grid
sections_instructions.guidelines: 6 cards. High-density grid. Use Lucide icons. Highlight 'Transport Médical (CPAM)' slightly differently (maybe a yellow badge or border) to show importance.

sections_instructions.name: Fleet Gallery
sections_instructions.guidelines: Showcase vehicles. Mercedes Classe E, S, V, Tesla Y. Use high-quality imagery. Large images with specs below. Make it feel luxurious but accessible.

sections_instructions.name: Zones Served
sections_instructions.guidelines: Use flex-wrap with Shadcn Badges (rounded-full bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 px-4 py-2 text-sm) for a chip-list aesthetic.

sections_instructions.name: Tarifs (Pricing)
sections_instructions.guidelines: Clean Shadcn Table inside a prominent container. White background, gray borders. Highlight the differences between Day/Night using light gray alternating rows.

sections_instructions.name: Advantages
sections_instructions.guidelines: Bento style grid. 6 small cards with icons focusing on reliability, 24/7, comfort, etc.

sections_instructions.name: Contact & Footer
sections_instructions.guidelines: Darker footer (bg-gray-900 text-white) to create contrast shift at the end, or keep it ultra-clean light (bg-gray-50). Big CTA 'Réservez votre trajet'. Contact info clearly visible.

sections_instructions.name: Booking Wizard (Modal)
sections_instructions.guidelines: 3 steps: 1. Trajet (Pickup, Dropoff, Date, Time) 2. Véhicule & Options 3. Identité (Name, Phone). Use a yellow progress bar. Form submission sends user data.

sections_instructions.name: Floating WhatsApp
sections_instructions.guidelines: Fixed bottom-right, z-50. Green WhatsApp icon. Pulse animation. Essential for mobile users.

hero.description: Sleek white Mercedes-Benz S-Class, perfect for the luxurious yet luminous hero section.

fleet_black_mercedes.description: Black Mercedes S Class for the fleet section.

service_airport.description: Chauffeur opening door, great for airport transfer or premium service card.

accessibility.contrast: Text on yellow button MUST be black (#000000) for WCAG AA. Text on white must be gray-900 or gray-700.
accessibility.touch_targets: All interactive elements on mobile must be minimum 48x48px (h-12 w-12).
accessibility.aria: Add aria-labels to all icon buttons (WhatsApp, Menu).

testing.data_testid: Add data-testid attributes to all major interactive elements: hero-book-button, hero-call-button, nav-book-button, whatsapp-float, wizard-step-1-next, form-submit, etc.

3d_libraries.usage: Not recommended for this specific local utility site to maintain fast load times, but consider framer-motion for smooth 2D entry animations.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap. Use padding inside bordered containers.
DO NOT use raw HTML forms, use Shadcn Form, Input, Select for the Booking Modal.
Ensure perfect mobile responsiveness. Stacking grids, side-scrolling for horizontal elements if needed, full width buttons.
